description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages, forwarding only the message content to the next LogNode in a chain, effectively stripping away metadata like tags and priorities. This is useful for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters log output to only pass the message content, omitting other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter()
methods.description: Default constructor allowing setting the next node later.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Processes the log message; forwards only the message to the next node if it exists.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
